comparison.objective: Wipe a monitor lead from plug end to clip end in one continuous pass.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand tensions/supports a flexible cable while the other maintains wiping contact along it.
comparison.success_condition: Required cable length is wiped in the specified direction without dropping, releasing, or damaging/displacing the lead.
comparison.reason: Flexible linear wiping and tension management do not test granular aperture flow or size-based retention. No material rubric detail is missing.
